    method "get",
    response_type "json",

) HEADER (

CREATE SCHEMASTORE VIEW v_au_snacks_115501 WITH CONTAINER psig AS
SELECT 'AU' AS country, 'snacks' AS concept, '115501' AS category_code, 'Snacks and confectionery' AS category_label,

  LATERAL VIEW explode(from_json(to_json(data.dataSets[0].series.`0:0:0:0:0`.observations), 'map<string,array<double>>')) AS obs_key, obs_value
  WHERE CAST(obs_key AS INT) = obs_position
) s
